subject: Searcher::line_terminator
prompt: Outside tests and examples, which functions or methods call the line_terminator getter of grep_searcher::Searcher (the searcher crate's Searcher type, crates/searcher/src/searcher/mod.rs)? Other line_terminator methods do not count: not the grep_matcher::Matcher trait method, not the SearcherBuilder or RegexMatcherBuilder setters, and not grep_regex's internal ConfiguredHIR::line_terminator. Name free functions as module::function using the file's module name (for example main::run), and methods as Type::method.
